entities.summary: Milíč of Kroměříž was a Czech Catholic priest and the most influential preacher of the emerging Bohemian Reformation in the 14th century. Together with other Bohemian preachers and writers of that time, he paved in a certain sense the way for the reforming activity of Jan Hus. He is sometimes known as Jan Milíč of Kroměříž in modern literature, but in historical sources he's only referred to as Milíč of Kroměříž.
